name: China Restaurant HongKong
kurzbeschreibung: HongKong China Restaurant in Reutte – where authentic flavors from the Far East meet the charm of Tirol. Enjoy delicious dishes like Peking duck, crispy Spring rolls, and fragrant Dim Sum in a cozy atmosphere. A culinary journey right in the heart of the Lechtal!
beschreibung: The China Restaurant HongKong in Reutte in the Außerfern region pampers its patrons with a wonderful array of regional and seasonal dishes. The kitchen combines beloved Tyrolean recipes with fresh creative ideas, resulting in a distinct dining experience. The inviting interior makes it easy to unwind, while the friendly team ensures attentive care. Highly recommended is the house-made Tyrolean dumpling soup, perfect for warming up after exploring the mountains. A curated wine list showcasing Austrian and regional vintages completes the experience.
